issue: On 25 Nov 2025 (AFTER GEM LastUpdated 2025-08-28) Timor-Leste's MPRM and Woodside signed a cooperation agreement to mature a greenfield ~5 mtpa ONSHORE/Timor-based LNG concept ('TLNG'), with a domestic-gas facility and helium extraction, first LNG possibly 2032-2035 subject to concept selection and FID. GEM currently models this terminal as FLNG: TerminalName='Sunrise FLNG Terminal', FacilityType='export', Offshore=True, Floating=True. The agreed concept under active study is an onshore plant on Timor-Leste's south coast (Beaco), which conflicts with the offshore/floating modeling. The earlier FLNG concept appears superseded as the favored path, but concept selection is still pending (no FID), so this is not yet a committed final design.
suggested_action: On next Update batch, consider whether to (a) re-model Offshore/Floating/FacilityType toward an onshore Timor-based plant and/or rename (note OtherNames already includes 'Beaco LNG Terminal'), or (b) hold as-is until concept selection. Do NOT auto-flip offshore/floating fields now — concept not yet selected. Sources: Government of Timor-Leste/MPRM release 25 Nov 2025 (https://timor-leste.gov.tl/?p=46200&lang=en); LNG Industry 26 Nov 2025 (https://www.lngindustry.com/liquid-natural-gas/26112025/mprm-and-woodside-sign-agreement-for-greater-sunrise/).
